messages:
ellie: Quick ask — can we borrow 8 GPUs in asia-southeast1 tonight for an interactive smoke run? ~2h window around 22:00 SGT, project redwood-demo-staging.
raj: which GPU type? h100 / a100? also do we need dedicated or preemptible?
essie: h100 preferred but can use a mix, dedicated > preemptible if possible (latency matters for the demo).
sophie: fyi vendor slot availability usually tight after 21:00 SGT. can you share exact start/end? i can ping vendor.
ellie: start 22:00 SGT, end 00:00 SGT (2 hours). if vendor can only do 4, we can run two sequential groups, but prefer parallel.
raj: checking quota now — running a quick `gcloud` check: `gcloud compute regions describe asia-southeast1 --format="json(quotas)" | jq '.quotas[] | select(.metric=="GPUS_all" )'`
raj: also looking at our internal reservation pool, may need a short terraform change to carve the extra slice.
sophie: could we use spot for half (4) and dedicated for the rest? cheaper and more likely to fit.
ellie: yeah ok to do 4 spot + 4 dedicated if that increases success probability.
darren: tagging finance-bot for cost OK — rough estimate for 2h of 8 H100s?
finance-bot: @darren please provide exact SKU and region, but ballpark for 8 H100s in asia region ~ $9-12k for 2 hours (on-demand) — need approval if > $5k.
raj: vendor responded — current immediate availability: 4 H100 dedicated for tonight, + up to 8 preemptible. they can carve 4 more dedicated but needs 24h lead. link to vendor ticket: https://vendor.example/tickets/RED-4932
sophie: ok so immediate option is 4 dedicated + 4 spot (fits ellie's ask). want me to open the terraform PR to reserve the 4 dedicated?
ellie: pls do the PR and add the time window tag. i'll approve. also set `env=smoke-demo` tag so finance tracking is simple.
raj: created PR https://git.internal/r/infra/terraform/PR-842 — plan looks clean, targeting module.gpu_reservation. snippet: ```terraform plan -var='region=asia-southeast1' -target=module.gpu_reservation```
ops-bot: Reservation automation kicked off for redwood-demo-staging. Reservation id rsv-20240318-67, pending vendor confirmation.
finance-bot: provisional approval granted for up to $6k immediate spend. escalate if vendor invoice exceeds this.
ellie: thanks everyone — will run the smoke at 22:00 SGT, will post short results in this thread. pls ping if slot / quota changes. :thumbsup:
